# v0.9.0b7 — Three clear charging choices

- **Charge target, next departure and guest charging:** replace the separate
  scheduled order, reserve and boost controls with three focused areas.
- **Shared HA and app controls:** save targets, departure and guest settings
  consistently, with protection against stale edits and vehicle changes.
- **Compact Mushroom dashboards:** native controls, state-aware icons and guidance
  in five languages; no extra helpers or custom wallbox card.
- **Reliability:** keep confirmed guest deadlines fixed, preserve deliberate
  permissions and report uncertain saves without retrying commands blindly.

Update the app first. The integration requires service **0.9.0b7 or newer**,
API 2. Old beta scheduled orders and drafts are not imported. Recheck departure,
vehicle selection, pause and Plug & Charge after updating.
